items.stem: What is the primary purpose of the user/kernel mode distinction in an operating system?

options.text: To protect privileged operations and hardware access behind controlled entry points
options.rationale: Correct: the boundary restricts privileged operations to the kernel via system calls.

options.text: To make user programs run faster
options.rationale: The distinction is about protection, not raw speed.

options.text: To avoid the need for a scheduler
options.rationale: Scheduling is still required regardless of the mode boundary.

options.text: To eliminate the need for virtual memory
options.rationale: Virtual memory is a separate mechanism from the privilege boundary.

items.explanation: Correct: the boundary restricts privileged operations to the kernel via system calls.

items.stem: Which TWO conditions must hold for a deadlock to be possible? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Mutual exclusion on at least one resource
options.rationale: Correct: mutual exclusion is one of the four Coffman conditions.

options.text: Circular wait among the blocked processes
options.rationale: Correct: a cycle of waiting processes is a necessary condition.
Deadlock requires no preemption, the opposite of this option.
Free memory is unrelated to the deadlock conditions.

items.explanation: Correct: mutual exclusion is one of the four Coffman conditions.

items.stem: Under a pure round-robin scheduler, what happens to a process when its time quantum expires?

options.text: It is preempted and moved to the back of the ready queue
options.rationale: Correct: round-robin preempts and requeues the process at quantum expiry.

options.text: It runs to completion before any other process
options.rationale: That describes non-preemptive scheduling, not round-robin.

options.text: It is terminated by the kernel
options.rationale: Quantum expiry preempts, it does not kill the process.

options.text: It is moved to permanent sleep
options.rationale: The process stays runnable and waits its next turn.

items.explanation: Correct: round-robin preempts and requeues the process at quantum expiry.
